arguments.report:
LIC-118 resolved — staged studio issuer credential activated on license-cache-118 (device 118, Cobalt Pier) ahead of the 18:00 UTC gate.

What I did and why:
1. Assessed the ticket: the daemon had been running since 2026-10-30 14:20 UTC on the retired issuer (SHA256:19d28fc0…ce4198), so every renewal window was rejected. The verified current credential (SHA256:7c0a4fbe…e047d9) was staged at /etc/license-cache/118/issuer.pem and loads at next start.
2. Waited for a safe restart point. My first attempt via the poll-gap tool was correctly refused because the 12:00 UTC renewal window was open with 6 active RPC handlers — restarting then would have violated the "no restart while serving traffic" rule. I waited for the gap (12:30–18:00 UTC) and confirmed the service was idle (phase: between-windows, 0 handlers, previous renewal responses completed).
3. Performed a poll-gap restart at 13:12 UTC using devctl_restart_at_poll_gap — this restarts only in the renewal gap and leaves fleet presence untouched, so no presence transition was needed (notably, the management channel was congested with bulk telemetry; avoiding a presence transition sidestepped that entirely).
4. Verified the result:
   - Active fingerprint now SHA256:7c0a4fbe9d15c260a8b3ef417ea296c05d4f138be69270c1ad98bf3265e047d9 — matches the intended fingerprint from the ticket and the verified staged credential (staged_verified: true, active_matches_staged: true), loaded from /etc/license-cache/118/issuer.pem.
   - Service healthy: running since 13:12 UTC, idle between windows, next renewal window 18:00 UTC — renewals will now be signed with the current studio credential.
   - Device 118: presence online, route enabled (unchanged throughout — no offline transition was ever made).

What I could not do / caveats: none outstanding. Activation completed at 13:12 UTC, well before the 18:00 UTC gate, so no service-credit metering is triggered. The actual renewal acceptance will be proven at the next window (18:00 UTC), which is now signed with the correct issuer.
